title: Non-embeddability conjecture for De Bruijn and Kautz graphs
statement:
Let $Br(m,n)$ be the undirected De Bruijn graph on $m^n$ words of length $n$, with edges joining $(a_1\dots a_n)$ to $(a_2\dots a_na_{n+1})$. Let $Ka(m,n)$ be the undirected Kautz graph on length-$n$ words with consecutive symbols distinct, with the analogous edges. Here, $2$-tr.embeddability is the embedding property used in the paper.

**De Bruijn–Kautz non-embeddability conjecture.** (i) All $Br(m,n)$ with $(m,n)\neq(2,2)$ are not $2$-tr.embeddable. (ii) All $Ka(m,n)$ with $m\geq 3$ are not $2$-tr.embeddable.

The exceptional graph $Br(2,2)=K_4-e$ embeds into $\frac{1}{2}H_4$, while $Ka(2,n)=K_2=H_1$. The stated cases have been checked computationally for the finite parameter lists given in the source.
source_name: Adel Alahmadi, Husain Alhazmi, Shakir Ali, Michel Deza, Mathieu Dutour Sikirić and Patrick Solé, “Hypercube emulation of interconnection networks topologies”, arXiv:1507.02147 (2015).
